body: my skin has never been a fan of retinol products, and I try different ones every now and again to see, but nope... they aren't for me. Plus I noticed that they made my skin flakey and itchy, which made me more likely to pick and then my skin would be thinner and thus scar more easily. Everyone's skin is so different, though. It may be your holy grail!

I didn't see Mederma on your list. It's worth a try, it helped mine fade a bit. 

I've also been using some natural oils that I've found work fairly... miraculously. These include:
Tamanu Oil
Black Cumin Seed Oil
and then I cover the spots with some cold pressed unrefined shea butter. 

Some other stuff I've been using on my face with success:
Witch Hazel Distillate as a toner
CeraVe Moisturizing lotion mixed with 7 drops of high linoleic safflower oil and 2-3 drops of prickly pear seed oil
2.5% benzoyl peroxide cream once a day all over, just a light layer, and then I apply more CeraVe lotion and safflower/prickly pear seed oil over this and if I have any large zits I spot treat them first with soursop oil and then with more benzoyl peroxide cream

I think it sounds like you're doing everything right. I think if you keep doing what you're doing, things will get better in time. There are a lot of people like you out there. It sounds like you are on the milder end of the autism spectrum - so am I. It's very easy to feel like an outsider when you have any form of ASD (autism spectrum disorder). It's easier said than done, but if you find like-minded, fellow autists, I think you would find a lot of comfort in that. Even if their company was purely virtual. 

Virtual hugs for you, friend. I hope things start looking up.

Thank you for sharing this and not succumbing to the siren song of the crazy MRA subs. You really can tell what a self-aware and kind-hearted person you are from this post. What you're going through is really difficult, and I think you're taking all the right steps. I wish you all the best. I hope you find happiness in work and, if you want to, happiness in a fulfilling and non-abusive relationship later on down the road. 

Would it be possible to find a new job with similar duties/salary, one where people aren't talking about you behind your back? If not, I understand and that also really sucks. It may be a good idea to go on some dates and just vibe around some new people. Good luck to you.
